# stapel-feed 0.1.0

Posts, comments, reactions and feeds for a community. Members post plain-text updates with up to ten uploaded pictures, public or for followers; others comment (flat, no threads) and react (one reaction per user per target, toggled, counted on the target in the same transaction). Four anchor-paginated reads: home (followed authors and own posts), public, one author's posts, one post with its comments. Following and blocks are read from profiles through one comm Function (profiles.social_graph); when it cannot be asked, home and public answer 503 rather than show a blocked author. Moderation takes a post or comment down through the moderation.completed verdict; GDPR erasure is a hard delete with counters recomputed.

Contract: axes 2 · surface 2 · extension points 6 · operations 11 · error codes 53 · flows 3.
Generated from docs/capabilities.json by `stapel-llms-txt` — do not edit; drift-gated by `make contract-check`.

## Configuration axes — what a product switches on
Settings keys; `default` is what you get by saying nothing. Turning an axis off unmounts the operations it gates.
- PUBLIC_READ [bool, default true] — Visitors can read
  Whether people without an account can read the public feed, profiles' post lists and single posts with their comments. true (default): an open community. false: members only. Values: true, false.
- WRITE_REQUIRES_ACCOUNT [bool, default true] — Who may post and comment
  Whether a guest session (no registered account) may post, comment and react. true (default): sign-in required. false: guests may write too. Values: true, false.

## Usage surface — call these before writing your own
This is the answer to "does Stapel already have something for X?". `instead of` names the outside symbol this one displaces.
### gate_function
- fetch_graph — stapel_feed.services.graph.fetch_graph
  Ask SOCIAL_GRAPH_FUNCTION about one viewer; raises GraphUnavailable instead of guessing. home and public turn that into 503.
- graph_or_unknown — stapel_feed.services.graph.graph_or_unknown
  The degrading form for single-object reads: the graph, NOBODY for an anonymous viewer, UNKNOWN when the Function is down (only public content is then shown).

## Extension points — what a product replaces, fork-free
- REACTION_KINDS [setting]
  The reaction vocabulary, default ('like',). Replace it to add 'heart' or others without a fork; an unknown kind answers error.400.reaction_kind_unknown.
- SOCIAL_GRAPH_FUNCTION [strategy]
  Dotted comm Function name answering {user_id, limit} -> {following, blocked, truncated}. Default profiles.social_graph; a host with its own graph replaces it. Unreachable means 503 on home and members' public, never an unfiltered feed.
- STAPEL_FEED_POST_PRESENTER / STAPEL_FEED_COMMENT_PRESENTER [presenter]
  Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for the post and comment response presenters, so a host changes what the API shows without forking a view.
- feed.post.created [comm_event]
  A post was published: post id, author, visibility. Bodies never ride the bus.
- feed.reaction.changed [comm_event]
  A reaction was set or removed on a post or comment, with the target's author, so a projection or a gamification layer can count.
- moderation.completed [comm_event]
  Consumed: a rejected verdict on a post or comment hides it from every read (the author sees it as blocked); an approved verdict on a blocked row publishes it again.

## Fits with — fleet dependencies
- stapel-cdn (optional) — uploads behind the attachment refs; cdn.describe_many fills the image objects (without it they keep the ref and say cdn_unavailable)
- stapel-core (required) — comm bus (feed.* emits, Functions, user.merged and moderation.completed consumers), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, AppSettings
- stapel-moderation (optional) — post and comment target types (registered by the stapel-social preset) read feed.moderation_content and take content down through moderation.completed
- stapel-notifications (optional) — feed.comment_received and feed.reaction_received reach the post author
- stapel-profiles (required) — profiles.social_graph (>=0.23) answers whom a viewer follows and whom to hide; profiles.public_cards renders author cards. Without the graph, home and members' public answer 503

## HTTP operations (11) — call by operationId, never by a typed path
Paths are relative to `/feed/api/v1/`.
### Feed
- GET /authors/{user_id}/posts/ — feed_authors_posts_list
- DELETE /comments/{comment_id}/ — feed_comments_destroy
- GET /home/ — feed_home_list
- POST /posts/{post_id}/comments/ — feed_posts_comments_create
- GET /posts/{post_id}/comments/ — feed_posts_comments_list
- POST /posts/ — feed_posts_create
- DELETE /posts/{post_id}/ — feed_posts_destroy
- PATCH /posts/{post_id}/ — feed_posts_partial_update
- GET /posts/{post_id}/ — feed_posts_retrieve
- GET /public/ — feed_public_list
- PUT /reactions/ — feed_reactions_update

## Documented flows (3) — full steps in docs/flows.json
- feed.post — Post an update
- feed.public_read — Read the community
- feed.react_comment — React and comment
